event.text: Please get your foot examined in person today — urgent care, your diabetes/foot clinic, or a podiatry service. In diabetes, a cut with spreading redness, swelling and tenderness can be an infection that needs the wound looked at, cleaned and possibly treated with antibiotics. Keep weight off the foot until seen. If you develop fever, chills, spreading redness, drainage, black skin or a foul smell, go to the emergency department right away.
